outcomes: Developed and verified the Universal Intelligent Compaction Retrofit Kit. Tested on flexible pavement layers (subgrade, GSB, WMM, DBM, BC) showing high CMV correlation to physical Proctor and Plate Load testing.

title: Automation & Intelligent Machine Guided Construction
description: A cost-effective, non-invasive Universal Intelligent Compaction (UIC) retrofit pod that transforms traditional road rollers into machine-guided control systems using EKF, FFT sensor fusion, and real-time CMV mapping.
overview: The Universal Intelligent Compaction (UIC) Kit is a cost-effective, non-invasive retrofit pod that transforms any traditional vibration roller into a Machine Guided Control System (MGCS). Utilizing deterministic physics models alongside advanced sensor fusion, the system estimates compaction density in real-time.
detailedOverview:
### Executive Summary
Standard highway compaction suffers from operator inconsistency, speed fluctuations, and a reliance on destructive core-cutting quality tests. The Universal Intelligent Compaction (UIC) Kit bridges this gap by retrofitting onto existing machinery. It maps pavement stiffness dynamically in real-time, preventing under-compaction and over-compaction.

### Problem Statement
1. **Operator Inconsistencies:** Operator fatigue leads to irregular pass overlaps, leaving parts of the pavement uncompacted.
2. **Speed Fluctuations:** Deviations from the optimal rolling speed of $3.2\text{ km/h}$ compromise compaction uniformity.
3. **Destructive Core Testing:** Current quality control relies on manual core cutting which only tests discrete locations, leaving vast pavement areas unverified.
4. **Structural Failures:** Under-compaction causes rutting and cracking, while over-compaction crushes aggregates and shears layers.

### Hardware & Sensor Fusion Architecture
The retrofit pod contains an edge computing brain fuzing multiple sensor streams:
- **Geospatial Tracking:** Roof-mounted RTK-GPS module for centimeter-level mapping.
- **Thickness & Elevation:** Downward-facing Time-of-Flight (ToF) LiDAR mapping bed thickness and surface settlement.
- **Thermal Monitoring:** Infrared (IR) thermometry sensor tracking active asphalt cooling windows.
- **Drum Dynamics:** Drum-mounted Triaxial Industrial ICP Accelerometers capturing vibration frequencies and damping.
- **Compute Brain:** A ruggedized Raspberry Pi IPC executing physics models at the edge.

### Mathematical Formulation & Algorithms
1. **Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) State Estimation:**
   To ensure high-accuracy tracking under severe vibrating conditions, an EKF fuses RTK-GPS coordinates with IMU data. The state vector is:
   $$x_k = [x, y, v_x, v_y, \theta]^T$$
   where $x,y$ represent geospatial coordinates, $v_x, v_y$ are velocity vectors, and $\theta$ is the heading angle.

2. **Vibration Spectrum & Compaction Index (CMV):**
   Soil stiffness changes the drum's behavior from simple harmonic motion to bouncing and hopping, creating sub-harmonic and harmonic frequencies. An FFT is computed over 512-point acceleration windows:
   $$X(f) = \sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x[n] \cdot e^{-i 2 \pi f \frac{n}{N}}$$
   The Compaction Meter Value (CMV) is derived from the ratio of the amplitude of the first harmonic ($A_{2\omega_0}$) to the fundamental frequency ($A_{\omega_0}$):
   $$\text{CMV} = C \cdot \frac{A_{2\omega_0}}{A_{\omega_0}}$$
   where $\omega_0$ is the drum excitation frequency (typically $30\text{ Hz}$) and $C$ is a calibration factor.

### Market Disruption & Cost Analysis
Traditional Intelligent Compaction rollers require purchasing brand-new heavy equipment, costing upwards of ₹50,000,000. The UIC Kit retrofits onto any existing roller, breaking the cost chasm with a ₹58,000 Bill of Materials:

| Component | Cost | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **RTK-GPS Module** | ₹30,000 | Centimeter-level pass tracking |
| **Raspberry Pi Edge IPC** | ₹8,000 | EKF and FFT processing |
| **ICP Accelerometer** | ₹2,500 | Drum vibration measurement |
| **LiDAR, Sensors & Case** | ₹17,500 | Thickness and thermal tracking |
| **Total Cost** | **₹58,000** | **Complete retrofit package** |

### Cloud Sync & Future Scope
The system outputs data in a standardized JSON format. Telemetry is piped into an **NHAI Unified Cloud Ledger**, feeding a centralized dashboard. This enables cross-project analytics and prevents vendor lock-in.
